Inventory audit → fill data → price → photos → listing copy → mark ready → publish.
Unique ID for every product/variant, e.g. BEA-001 or HOM-001.
Enter actual expiry for applicable beauty products. Never hide short expiry.
Keep cost, target, minimum and market reference separate.
Hero = attention; Traffic = attractive entry price; Profit = stronger economics; Clearance = move stock; Bundle = slower stock; Premium/Rare = limited high-end finds.
Yes only when photos, description, price, stock, condition and relevant expiry are complete.
Do not list products you are not authorized to sell.
Use real photos and evidence; do not make unsupported authenticity claims.
Present in site code but absent from the 57-row master. Confirm whether to add with verified details or remove from the site.
Confirm whether these should carry Nook & Glow as the product brand; the master leaves Brand blank.
Confirm packaging names, especially Fleur versus fluer.
Draft useful original product descriptions as part of the SEO work. Owner supplies or verifies product facts and approves claims before publishing; no writing task was assigned to the owner.
Image Ready fields are blank. Confirm SKU to main/secondary image mapping before publication.
Listing Ready fields are blank. Keep as drafts until reviewed.
Most entries say Open to expiry. Verify actual expiry where applicable before publishing.
Category exists in the website, but no fragrance items are listed in this master.
Product type is present. Skin concern, skin type, fragrance notes, audience and other claims require separate verified fields.
Market Price was date-formatted in the subcategory file; restored numeric values from the original template. Target Price and Quantity were unchanged.
Unassigned products should remain searchable by name, type and brand; do not assign a concern merely to fill every row.
Name-derived matches need review against packaging or an official brand page before use in public SEO copy or indexed concern pages.
Blemish-prone and post-acne marks are distinct. Search can interpret an acne query broadly but show precise product labels.
Build crawlable category/product pages, stable slugs, unique metadata, canonicals, sitemap rules and internal links before publishing concern landing pages.
